filesToTouch.what: The transport obligation section (SIBLING-SET-PLAN §3.1 row 'transport.js', verbatim). Exports (each a fresh-UUID obligation object, camelCase path-safe names): borderControlPost (mandatory), inspectionPremises (applyTo: allowListed(borderControlPost, perBcpControlPoints, null, reasons) — the per-BCP control-point map resolved LAZILY at gate execution from sets/plant-products/services/reference/bcps.js (pp-015); commodities gates are the lazy-resolution exemplar), meansOfTransport (mandatory), transportIdentification (mandatory), transportDocumentReference (mandatory), arrivalDate (mandatory), arrivalTime (mandatory), usesContainers (mandatory bool), containers GROUP (no status, no requires — applyTo: equalsGate(usesContainers, true, reasons)), and members within: containers (object-identity reference): containerNumber (optional), sealNumber (optional), officialSeal (optional). NO copy, options, labels or validation in this file (obligation-purity enforced at boot). Helpers from src/server/app/model/obligations/helpers/index.js only — no new helper needed.

Import + re-export every transport.js obligation and append all of them to the obligations array. groups stays derived (never hand-edited); policy untouched (no enforcedAtContinue addition for this section, no maxEntriesFrom entry — plan §3.3).

Pin the inspectionPremises allowlist against sets/plant-products/services/reference/bcps.js: for a BCP with premises the gate admits exactly that BCP's premises codes and rejects a control value (a premises code belonging to a different BCP); for a BCP with no premises the obligation is out of scope. CREATE the file with this as its first suite if pp-021/pp-025 have not yet landed it (T-7 names it m3; this increment's dependsOn does not include m3, so create-if-absent).
export const transportBeforeBipPage = { id: '<fresh-uuid>', slug: 'transport-before-bip' } — import-free (controller and flow import the same object; prevents the controller↔flow module cycle).

Feature binding bundle: scalar({ field, obligation }) for borderControlPost, inspectionPremises, meansOfTransport, transportIdentification, transportDocumentReference, arrivalDate, arrivalTime, usesContainers; a group descriptor for containers ({ field: 'containers', token, obligation: containers }) and grouped({ field, obligation, groups: [container] }) for containerNumber, sealNumber, officialSeal (depth-1 chain — binding depth must equal the within chain). convert on arrivalDate (three D/M/Y inputs → ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD') and arrivalTime (hour+minutes inputs → 'HH:mm' string, the backend shape).

export const meta = { ...transportBeforeBipPage, collects: ['borderControlPost', 'inspectionPremises', 'meansOfTransport', 'transportIdentification', 'transportDocumentReference', 'arrivalDate', 'arrivalTime', 'usesContainers', 'containers'] } (container members inherit the owning page from the group root). GET: state.get() ONCE; prefill from answers; premises select options resolved from bcps.js for the currently-answered/selected BCP (out-of-scope → not rendered); containers rows via state.collectionView(answers, ['containers']) — facts only, controller builds its own row view-models. POST branches on the submit action (documents-exemplar single-page loop): (a) action === 'add-container' → validate the entry row (at-least-one of containerNumber/sealNumber — controller fieldset rule, NOT model, house D-13 parity; max lengths 32/100) then state.appendEntry(request, h, 'containers', entry); (b) action === 'remove-container:<index>' → Number.isInteger index guard + look the instance up and refuse a forged/stale index, then state.removeEntry; (c) default Save/Continue → validate every in-scope field with factories from src/server/app/lib/validate/index.js — BCP membership rule built inside POST from the bcps.js fixture (never a frozen module-level schema), premises validated against the POSTed BCP's own allowlist (so a 400 re-render shows the premises options for the newly-chosen BCP — the no-JS way premises follows BCP), single-layer Joi with ONE canonical message per rule (c-018), arrivalDate real-date + window [today, today+90] inclusive, arrivalTime 24-hour validity; invalid → 400 re-render RAW values; valid → state.commit() cleaned values, kit.recoverableSave() (marked failure → recoverableError re-render 500, other errors throw), redirect via await kit.nextTarget(request, page, committed.scope). Never commit an out-of-scope value (engine wipes premises when the BCP changes off-allowlist, and container rows when usesContainers flips to No). All row/back/internal links wrapped in kit.withChangeContext. Copy via copyFor({ en, cy }); routes via kit.pageRoutes(page, { get, post }).

Extends shared/layout.njk (unprefixed); view name under the plant TEMPLATES prefix. govuk-caption-xl 'Description of the goods'; H1 'Transport to the Border Control Post (BCP)'. Controls (all govuk macros, no custom CSS): govukSelect Entry border control post (options from bcps.js, placeholder first); govukSelect Inspection premises rendered ONLY when the selected BCP offers premises, options filtered to that BCP; H2 'Means of transport to the BCP' + govukSelect with a REAL visible label 'Means of transport to the BCP' (drop the legacy 'Choose from:' non-label), options from transport-options.js (pp-016); govukInput Transport identification (hint verbatim from the page spec, aria-describedby wired); govukRadios usesContainers 'Are any road trailers or shipping containers being used to transport the consignment?' with NO pre-selected default (fixes the confirmed GDS anti-pattern) and a conditional reveal containing: read-back rows table (container/seal/official-seal per row) each with a Remove submit button (action=remove-container:<index> so the crumb travels — no GET deletes), entry inputs Container or trailer number (visible label, hint) + Seal number + Official seal checkbox WITH a real visible label 'This is an official seal' (fixes the official-seal-1 accessible-name defect), and an 'Add another container or trailer' govuk-button--secondary (action=add-container); govukInput Transport document reference; H2 'Estimated arrival at BCP' + stock govukDateInput D/M/Y (NO custom datepicker — dropped per spec ruling) with hint id + fieldset aria-describedby wired; a REAL fieldset legend 'Time of estimated arrival' (govuk-fieldset__legend--m wrapping the heading — fixes the bare-div defect) over two govukInput govuk-input--width-2 Hour/Minutes fields per the GDS asking-for-a-time pattern, hint wired; shared error summary ('There is a problem', links focus controls — input name = id = error key throughout); shared save actions (house Save and continue / Save and return pattern from the live-animals exemplar, not the legacy double-primary); Back link is a real href via the house back-link helper.

English bundle — every user-facing string for the page: caption, heading, per-field labels/hints (spec-verbatim hints for identification, containers question, container number, seal number, official seal, document reference, date 'For example, 27 3 2023', time 24-hour hint), containers table/add/remove copy, and ONE canonical error message per rule generated from the VISIBLE labels (never the legacy strings): 'Select the entry border control post'; 'Select the inspection premises'; 'Select the means of transport to the BCP'; 'Enter the transport identification'; 'Transport identification must be 50 characters or fewer'; 'Enter the transport document reference'; 'Transport document reference must be 32 characters or fewer'; 'Enter the estimated arrival date at the BCP'; 'The estimated arrival date must be a real date'; 'The estimated arrival date must be today or within the next 90 days'; 'Enter the estimated arrival time at the BCP'; 'Enter a time using the 24-hour format, for example 14 50'; 'Select yes if road trailers or shipping containers are being used'; 'Enter a container or trailer number, or a seal number'; 'Container or trailer number must be 32 characters or fewer'; 'Seal number must be 100 characters or fewer'.

Copy test per the house pattern (bundle shape + key presence for both locales).

Single page owning both scalars and a depth-1 gated collection: add-a-section supplies section/row/hub wiring, add-a-collection (documents single-page-loop exemplar: sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/{controller.js,template.njk}) supplies the add/remove POST-branch pattern; live-animals features/transport/ is the section-registration exemplar. Rulings applied from the page spec: dropped the defra-datepicker (unexercised by every trace and test — low-risk drop), no pre-selected 'No' on usesContainers (confirmed GDS anti-pattern; the reason the reveal had zero legacy coverage), real time fieldset legend replacing the bare govuk-heading-m div, wired hints, visible Official seal label, error copy generated from visible labels (spec discrepancies[3]), one message per field resolving the legacy frontend-vs-submission-model mandatoriness conflicts in favour of MANDATORY (plan §3.1 marks identification/documentReference/date/time all mandatory — single-layer validation c-018, no draft-vs-submit split). Premises-follows-BCP is server-rendered (zero client XHR): GET renders premises for the answered BCP; a POST that changes the BCP validates premises against the new BCP's allowlist and the 400 re-render presents the new BCP's options — the allowListed gate owns scope/wipe. Legacy etag/optimistic concurrency deliberately not carried (whole-document PUT last-write-wins, §6.2/Open Q 3). Legacy MAX_CONTAINERS=70 recorded but not built (plan declares no caps).
